def transform(grid):
    # Replicate the object motif from each patterned tile into blank tiles,
    # respecting complete uniform separator rows and columns.
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]

    def spans(n, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]

    row_parts, col_parts = spans(h, row_seps), spans(w, col_seps)
    tiles = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_parts):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_parts):
            score = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            tiles.append((score, ri, ci))
    _, source_ri, source_ci = max(tiles)
    sr0, sr1 = row_parts[source_ri]
    sc0, sc1 = col_parts[source_ci]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_parts):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_parts):
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    value = grid[sr0 + (r - r0) % (sr1 - sr0)][sc0 + (c - c0) % (sc1 - sc0)]
                    if value != bg:
                        out[r][c] = value
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The grid is a 5-by-3 arrangement of rooms divided by complete
    # rows/columns of color 9. Mark a room 1 when it contains at least
    # two cells of color 4; otherwise mark it with its background color 8.
    sep = 9
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + hr + [h], [-1] + vc + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1])
                     for c in range(cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1])]
            row.append(1 if cells.count(4) >= 2 else 8)
        out.append(row)
    return out
